Part of being a suicide survivor includes identifying triggers. Identify what sets off the negative thoughts. Is it time alone? Stressful situations? Shame? Whatever the trigger, make use of the safety plan. #Bell Lets Talk

Safety Plan #5: Go to the emergency room. #6. Once treated, Once things are a bit more settled, it is important that you address the cause or causes of your suicidal thoughts in as far as possible. #Bell Lets Talk
Other suicide warnings are increased alcohol or drug use, recent and uncharacteristic impulsiveness, threatening suicide and a plan for death. #Bell Lets Talk
Warning signs of suicide for lawyers include unrelenting low mood, hopelessness, withdrawal, desperation, and sleep problems. #Bell Lets Talk
